description: List providers and their PINNED versions for a Terraform root module (default: cwd). Call this first so code targets the versions actually locked in .terraform.lock.hcl, not the latest release. Lists only the providers locked in THIS directory; it does not search the registry. For registry search, provider docs or the latest version, use the official terraform MCP server (search_provider_docs / get_latest_provider_version). Executes code: unless the schema is cached, this runs `terraform providers schema`, which starts the provider plugins installed under dir/.terraform/providers (with credential environment variables removed; they still run as your user).

dir.description: Terraform root module directory (must already be initialized), inside the server's directory or TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS. Default: TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

name: tf_list_providers
